ImportJob.description: An ImportJob allow defining a repository artifact to poll for discovering Services and APIs mocks and tests

active.description: Whether this ImportJob is active (ie. scheduled for execution)

lastImportError.description: Error message of last import (if any)

mainArtifact.description: Flag telling if considered as primary or secondary artifact. Default to `true`

name.description: Unique distinct name of this ImportJob

repositoryDisableSSLValidation.description: Whether to disable SSL certificate verification when checking repository

repositoryUrl.description: URL of mocks and tests repository artifact

secretRef.description: Reference of a Secret to used when checking repository

resource.description: Name of Keycloak resource/application used on client side

LabelsMap.description: A map which keys are already used labels keys and values are already used values for this key

MessageArray.description: Array of Message for Service operations

Metadata.description: Commodity object for holding metadata on any entity. This object is inspired by Kubernetes metadata.

Operation.description: An Operation of a Service or API

bindings.description: Map of protocol binding details for this operation

defaultDelay.description: Default response time delay for mocks

inputName.description: Name of input parameters in case of Xml based Service

name.description: Unique name of this Operation within Service scope

outputName.description: Name of output parameters in case of Xml based Service

parameterContraints.description: Contraints that may apply to mock invocatino on this operation

resourcePaths.description: Paths the mocks endpoints are mapped on

OperationHeaders.description: Specification of additional headers for a Service/API operations. Keys are operation name or "globals" (if header applies to all), values are Header objects DTO.

OperationOverrideDTO.description: Data Transfer object for grouping the mutable properties of an Operation

defaultDelay.description: Default delay in milliseconds to apply to mock responses on this operation

dispatcher.description: Type of dispatcher to apply for this operation

dispatcherRules.description: Rules of dispatcher for this operation

parameterConstraints.description: Constraints that may apply to incoming parameters on this operation

ParameterConstraint.description: Companion object for Operation that may be used to express constraints on request parameters

mustMatchRegexp.description: Whether it's a regular expression matching constraint

Request.description: A mock invocation or test request

name.description: Unique distinct name of this Request

operationId.description: Identifier of Operation this Request is associated to

testCaseId.description: Unique identifier of TestCase this Request is attached (in case of a test)

request.description: The request part of the pair

response.description: The Response part of the pair

Resource.description: Resource represents a Service or API artifacts such as specification, contract

id.description: Uniquer identifier of this Service or API Resource

name.description: Unique name/business identifier for this Service or API resource

path.description: Relatvie path of this resource regarding main resource

type.description: Type of this Service or API resource

Secret.description: A Secret allows grouping informations on how to access a restricted resource such as a repsoitory URL. Secrets are typically used by ImpoortJobs.

SecretRef.description: Lightweight reference for an existing Secret

name.description: Distinct name of the referenced Secret

Service.description: Represents a Service or API definition as registred into Microcks repository

id.description: Unique identifier for this Service or API

name.description: Distinct name for this Service or API (maybe shared among many versions)

operations.description: Set of Operations for Service or API

version.description: Distinct version for a named Service or API

xmlNS.description: Associated Xml Namespace in case of Xml based Service

ServiceRef.description: Lightweight reference of an existing Service

ServiceView.description: Aggregate bean for grouping a Service an its messages pairs

messagesMap.description: Map of messages for this Service. Keys are operation name, values are array of messages for this operation

SnapshotUpload.description: Upload of a repository snapshot file

TestCaseResult.description: Companion objects for TestResult. Each TestCaseResult correspond to a particuliar service operation / action reference by the operationName field. TestCaseResults owns a collection of TestStepResults (one for every request associated to service operation / action).

elapsedTime.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds since the test case beginning

operationName.description: Name of operation this test case is bound to

success.description: Flag telling if test case is a success

testStepResults.description: Test steps associated to this test case

operationName.description: Name of related operation for this TestCase

TestConformanceMetric.description: Represents the test conformance metrics (current score, history and evolution trend) of a Service

aggregationLabelValue.description: Value of the label used for metrics aggregation (if any)

currentScore.description: Current test conformance score for the related Service

lastUpdateDay.description: The day of latest score update (in yyyyMMdd format)

latestScores.description: History of latest scores (key is date with format yyyyMMdd, value is score as double)

maxPossibleScore.description: Maximum conformance score that can be reached (depends on samples expresiveness)

serviceId.description: Unique identifier of the Service this metric is related to

TestRequest.description: Test request is a minimalist wrapper for requesting the launch of a new test

filteredOperations.description: A restriction on service operations to test

secretName.description: The name of Secret to use for connecting the test endpoint

serviceId.description: Unique identifier of service to test

testEndpoint.description: Endpoint to test for this service

timeout.description: The maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for this test ends

TestResult.description: Represents the result of a Service or API test run by Microcks. Tests are related to a service and made of multiple test cases corresponding to each operations / actions composing service. Tests are run against a specific endpoint named testedEndpoint. It holds global markers telling if test still ran, is a success, how many times is has taken and so on ...

elapsedTime.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds since test beginning

inProgress.description: Flag telling is test is still in progress

secretRef.description: The referrence of the Secret used for connecting to test endpoint

success.description: Flag telling if test is a success

testCaseResults.description: TestCase results associated to this test

testDate.description: Timestamp of creation date of this service

testNumber.description: Incremental number for tracking number of tests of a service

timeout.description: The maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for this test ends

TestResultSummary.description: Represents the summary result of a Service or API test run by Microcks.

success.description: Flag telling if test is a success

testDate.description: Timestamp of creation date of this service

TestReturn.description: TestReturn is used for wrapping the return code of a test step execution

code.description: Return code for test (0 means Success, 1 means Failure)

eventMessage.description: Event Message received for this test

TestRunnerType.description: Type of test strategy (different strategies are implemented by different runners)

TestStepResult.description: TestStepResult is an entity embedded within TestCaseResult. They are created for each request associated with an operation / action of a microservice.

elapsedTime.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds since the test step beginning

eventMessageName.description: Name of event this test step is bound to

message.description: Error message that may be associated to this test step

requestName.description: Name of request this test step is bound to

success.description: Flag telling if test case is a success

eventMessage.description: Asynchronous message for this unidirectional event

UnidirectionalEvent.description: Representation of an unidirectional exchange as an event message

WeightedMetricValue.description: Value of a metric with an associated weight

weight.description: Weight of this metric value (typically a percentage)

jwt-bearer.description: JWT Bearer acquired using OAuth 2 Authentication flow or Direct Access Grant
